english:
Kills have an 85% chance to count toward a counter, which spawns an Elemental Pickup matching your Super's element at 4 points.

Kills needed and points per Kill:
• Firesprites and <void Void Breaches />: 4–5 kills, 1 point
• Ionic Traces and <stasis Stasis Shards />: 8–10 kills, 0.5 points
• <strand Tangles />: 10–12 kills, 0.4 points

Guardians grant 2x points.

Kills also trigger the global cooldown for Firesprites, Breaches, and Tangles. Kills scored during that cooldown do not count toward the next Pickup.

Matching the Damage Type to your Super's element has no bonus effect.
